items.title: Anatomy of a (Postgres) search engine — PlanetScale
items.summary: PlanetScale's TIN (Term-Inverted-Normalization) is a full-text search index for Postgres, supporting features like sorting and matching by exact value, range, or prefix. An inverted index is used to locate documents quickly by words, and a term dictionary maps terms to postings lists.

items.title: 1D Terrain Generation
items.summary: 1D terrain generation is a process of creating random terrain for computer games, with the goal of mimicking natural terrain as closely as possible. A naive solution uses the random function to generate terrain, but this approach has limitations.

items.title: Master-Replica Replication
items.summary: Master-Replica Replication is a high-level architectural pattern used in distributed systems, where multiple nodes hold identical copies of data. The Master node handles writes, while Replicas cater to read requests.
